retro.summary: Repair round 2 addressed the browser-QA failures observed in verify-2 for the Chinese device after-sales service and inspection application. Fixes: a missing auth guard caused GET /service-engineers 500; the client referenced 371 service.* translation keys that did not exist (new service-en/service-zh locale modules spread into en-US/zh-CN with compile-time parity); collaborator and observer access rules were corrected server- and client-side (an observer now reads the non-confidential register with laborHours/internalCost masked and no write path, including attachment upload/delete); createOne calls now write timestamps so POST /service-customers and /service-devices no longer 500; order transitions write a createdAt so the history no longer errors; uploads validate size/type/signature and surface the real reason; assistant references JSON is parsed; the dashboard gained region/priority filters plus region and engineer distributions; a scheduler-based recurring inspection/order-overdue provider replaced a private cron manager and the weekly plan frequency was corrected; automatic acceptance now records its steps in the order history with retained failures and idempotent retry; a new seed adds the missing regional/collaborator/observer roles, service teams with a workspace-selectable subject type and inheritance, order collaborations (including a confidential one that stays invisible), the order recovery example and in-box messages. All checks (format, lint, three typechecks, 309 tests) pass; db apply and the seed were validated on a fresh database, and a standalone boot confirmed the three schedules sync, team inheritance resolves without a direct role, and the observer/collaborator/coordinator record scopes behave as intended. Repair round 3 addressed the verify-3 browser-QA defects. Group 1: POST /service-devices no longer writes an explicit null into the NOT NULL service_devices.category column when the form leaves Category blank, so the database default applies and the create succeeds; the values assembly was extracted as deviceCreateValues and covered by tests/logic/service-device-create.test.ts. Group 2: every application Select root now passes items so the closed trigger and form dropdowns render translated labels instead of raw stored values (customer id, running status, order priority/source, and the all/__all__ filter sentinels); the missing service.level.basic value was added to SERVICE_LEVELS and both service locale files; and server-side rejections were moved from hard-coded Chinese to request-locale keys via server/services/errors.ts plus typed server/locales en-US/zh-CN, covered by tests/logic/server-error-locale.test.ts. The relevant self-tests (device-create, server-error-locale, locale-coverage, client-routes), Prettier, ESLint and all three typechecks pass. Repair round 4 addressed the verify-4 browser-QA failures around cross-region knowledge sharing and the inspection execution view. Group 1: migration 202609010007 adds the application-owned knowledge_shares table (articleId, teamId, teamName, region, reason, grantedById, grantedByName, active, revokedAt, timestamps, unique articleId+teamId) and an inspection_plans.timezone column; server/routes/knowledge.ts now resolves the caller's service-team memberships (Caller.teamIds), keeps a restricted article to coordinators, its author and explicitly shared teams, exposes GET /knowledge-share-teams, GET/POST /knowledge-articles/:id/shares and POST .../shares/:shareId/revoke, and returns canShare per row; the knowledge page gained a cross-region share dialog with per-team revoke. Group 2: the inspection page shows each plan's timezone and the plan form edits it, and a new 'Schedules & history' tab reads GET /api/schedules and GET /api/schedules/:id/occurrences (enable/disable via POST) so the schedule name, cron, timezone, enable state, next/last run, run counts and each execution's status/reason/start/finish/result are visible. Seed 202609010008 turns the catch-all '华东区域通用设备周巡检' into a daily plan (the root cause of 'Generated 0 task(s)' and a newly added device producing no task), backfills plan timezones, grants page:scheduler.schedules access plus settings:scheduler.schedules read to every permission set that reaches the inspection page, seeds one worked cross-region share to ST-SOUTH, and corrects the matching in-app notice. The article-visibility rule was extracted into server/services/knowledge.ts and planDueOn exported for test; new tests/logic/knowledge-sharing.test.ts and tests/logic/inspection-schedule.test.ts cover coordinator/author/team access, revocation, customer/integrator exclusion, catch-all daily coverage and the weekly non-Monday gap. All three typechecks, Prettier, ESLint on the touched files and 325 tests pass. Repair round 5 (incomplete when its process was killed, completed and verified in repair round 6) addressed the verify-6 browser-QA failures. Group 1: the customer, device and order lists gained a region filter (previously only the dashboard had one) — the order list now sends region to GET /service-orders and the server filters visible orders, while the customer and device lists filter the fetched rows, deriving a device's region from its customer; /service-regions supplies the distinct values. Group 2: attachment preview was made robust — a valid XLSX that omitted the optional xl/styles.xml is completed before loading so the Office viewer no longer reports 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.', and PDFs are rendered to canvases in the dialog's own document with pdfjs-dist instead of the browser's built-in viewer, which had navigated the tab to about:blank and dropped the session. Group 3: orders created from the report form now inherit their region from the device or, when the device has none, from its customer, and migration 202609010009 backfills the region of existing orders so the dashboard's region distribution covers every order. Repair round 6 confirmed each fix against the factory browser fixtures (raw vs normalized XLSX in headless Chromium, and the pdfjs canvas path on sample.pdf), added tests/logic/order-create-region.test.ts, removed a leftover staged .tmp-ooxml-test/ scratch directory, and reran Prettier, ESLint on the touched files, all three typechecks and the relevant logic tests (22 passed). Repair round 7 addressed the verify-7 browser-QA defect that the root/unrestricted account (nocobase) saw no options in the customer, device and order Region filters while its dashboard region filter was complete. Root cause: hasRole() short-circuits to true for isRoot, so the restricting predicates isCustomer/isIntegrator/isObserver all returned true for root; isCustomer then scoped those lists to caller.customerId (null for root) and returned empty, while /dashboard/summary checks isCoordinator first and therefore still listed every region. Fixed by adding hasExplicitRole() to server/services/access.ts and using it for isCustomer, isIntegrator and isObserver, so root is unrestricted rather than impersonating a restriction role; isCoordinator and isEngineer keep the root bypass. Added tests/logic/access-roles.test.ts pinning that root is a coordinator/writer/internal-field reader but not a customer, integrator or observer, and that explicit roles still match. Touched-file Prettier, ESLint and tsconfig.server typecheck pass, plus the four relevant logic test files (16 tests). Repair round 8 addressed the verify-8 browser-QA defect that the device and customer list search boxes did not reset pagination: an onChange that only called setSearch left the page on a now non-existent page, so a one-page result rendered as an empty page with the indicator showing "2 / 1". Both search handlers now also call setPage(1), matching the existing region/status filters, and a new tests/components/service-list-search-pagination.test.tsx renders both lists against fixed fixtures, moves to page 2, searches a code that lives on page 1 and asserts "1 / 1" with no "2 / 1". The new test, touched-file Prettier, ESLint and the client tsc typecheck pass. Repair round 9 addressed five verify-9 browser-QA defects. (1) The customer and device edit dialogs kept the values typed into a previous failed submission because they stay mounted across opens and merge local overrides over the newly selected record; each is now remounted per open session with a state-derived key, covered by tests/components/service-customer-form.test.tsx. (2) The reassign dialog had no reason field and the history recorded no reason: the dialog now requires a reason when the order already has an assignee, assignOrder() sends it, the server rejects a reassignment without one (400 assignReasonRequired) and writes the reason into the order log, covered by tests/components/order-assign-reason.test.tsx. (3) The customer Region field was not required and a blank value caused a NOT NULL 500 because customerValues() wrote an explicit null: the form validates it client-side with per-field feedback, the create route answers 400 customerRegionRequired, and an update that omits it leaves the stored value alone; covered by tests/logic/service-customer-region.test.ts. (4) The dashboard Knowledge articles count ignored article permissions (6 vs 5) because the dashboard never applied canReadArticle; a shared visibleArticles() helper now drives both the list and the count, covered by a new case in tests/logic/knowledge-sharing.test.ts. (5) The docx/pptx previews that the harness reported stuck on "Loading preview..." could not be reproduced under plain Chrome/Playwright, the real agent-browser CLI, CPU throttling or background-tab emulation; the strongest source difference (progressiveLayout, used only by docx/pptx while the working xlsx does not) was removed, the translator identity was stabilized through a ref, and a bounded 30s timeout now surfaces the real error instead of an endless spinner, covered by a fake-timer case in tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx. Touched-file Prettier, ESLint, the client and server typechecks and the 41 relevant tests pass; the docx/pptx path still needs a full browser re-verification. Repair round 10 addressed two verify-10 browser-QA defects. (1) A customer's Remark field was sent on update but came back null and was blank after a refresh because customerValues() in server/routes/service-data.ts never copied body.remark; it now trims and persists the value (null when omitted), covered by extended cases in tests/logic/service-customer-region.test.ts. (2) The New order dialog had no save-as-draft path - both of its buttons created pending_assignment orders - and opening the seeded Draft SO-2026-0007 and choosing Move to Pending assignment left the status at Draft: the form now carries an explicit draft/submit intent behind named Save draft and Submit buttons (a draft may omit the fault description and skips automatic acceptance), and the order detail page now takes the server's per-order availableTransitions list (added to GET /service-orders/:id) so a plain advance applies in one click while a reason-bearing move opens the dialog; returning a finished order now requires a reason. Covered by tests/logic/order-draft-submit.test.ts, tests/logic/order-create-payload.test.ts, tests/components/order-create-dialog.test.tsx, tests/components/order-transition-actions.test.tsx and tests/logic/order-transition-route.test.ts. Touched-file Prettier, ESLint, the client and server typechecks and the 42 relevant tests pass.

blockers.title: Prettier rejected 5 newly written server files
blockers.symptom: pnpm format:check '!.github/**' reported code style issues in server/routes/attachments.ts, server/routes/inspections.ts, server/routes/service-assistant.ts, server/routes/service-orders.ts and server/services/orders.ts.
blockers.rootCause: The service-system server files were written without Prettier formatting; the per-file format:auto step in verify.sh only formats the files that stage considered changed, so the aggregate format:check later saw unformatted files.
blockers.resolution: Ran prettier --write on the affected files (and later on the newly touched files) so pnpm format:check '!.github/**' passes.

blockers.title: eslint no-base-to-string across server routes and services
blockers.symptom: pnpm lint --ignore-pattern '.github/**' failed with about 102 no-base-to-string errors where String(value) or template interpolation was applied to RepositoryRecord field values.
blockers.rootCause: RepositoryRecord is Record<string, RepositoryMutationScalarValue>; the value union includes objects and arrays, so String() on it can stringify '[object Object]' and eslint forbids it.
blockers.resolution: Added a single toText(value: unknown): string helper in server/services/text.ts (null/undefined to '', strings as-is, number/bigint/boolean via String(), Date via toString(), otherwise '') and replaced the flagged stringifications across server routes and services. Verified String() on narrowed primitives is lint-safe.

blockers.title: eslint no-unsafe-* after an earlier eslint --fix removed type assertions
blockers.symptom: eslint server reported no-unsafe-assignment/member-access/call/return errors, concentrated in server/routes/service-assistant.ts.
blockers.rootCause: An earlier eslint --fix removed type assertions that were actually load-bearing (for example the shape of app.config.get('ai')), leaving values typed as any that then flowed into property access and calls.
blockers.resolution: Fixed forward rather than re-running --fix: reintroduced a runtime type guard isLlmServicesConfig for the LLM configuration and kept the surrounding values typed, so the assertions are no longer needed. pnpm lint --ignore-pattern '.github/**' passes.

blockers.title: Client lint errors: unused imports, react-refresh export, non-lazy useState
blockers.symptom: eslint client database reported unused useServiceFormatters/useMemo/ServiceCustomer imports, a react-refresh/only-export-components error in client/pages/service/ui.tsx, and useState(today()) initializers.
blockers.rootCause: Leftovers from refactoring plus a hook and component exported from the same module, which react-refresh rejects, plus calling a function during render as a useState initial value.
blockers.resolution: Removed the unused imports; extracted the ServiceFormatters interface and useServiceFormatters hook into client/pages/service/formatters.ts and updated the seven importing pages; made the inspections useState calls lazy (useState(() => today())). eslint client database passes.

blockers.title: Seed lint errors: unbound-method and no-base-to-string
blockers.symptom: database/main/seeds/202609010003_sample_data.ts failed lint with unbound-method on a destructured repository and no-base-to-string on seed record fields.
blockers.rootCause: SeedContext.repository is a method, so destructuring it in the run signature detached it from this; and RepositoryRecord field values may be objects, so String(record.name) is unsafe.
blockers.resolution: Changed the seed to run(context) and use context.repository(name) plus const { query } = context, and added a local text(value: unknown): string helper for the two stringified seed fields.

blockers.title: TS2339 from .catch(() => ({})) fallback unions
blockers.symptom: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json reported Property 'X' does not exist on type 'Record<string, unknown> | {}' in server/routes/inspections.ts, integrations.ts and service-assistant.ts.
blockers.rootCause: A fetch JSON parse typed as .json<Record<string, unknown>>() chained with .catch(() => ({})) inferred a union with the empty object literal, so member access on the result was not allowed.
blockers.resolution: Typed the fallback explicitly with .catch((): Record<string, unknown> => ({})) instead of using an as assertion, which would have tripped no-unnecessary-type-assertion. tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit passes.

blockers.title: Source-loaded seeds could not resolve sibling .js specifiers
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts failed: Cannot find module '/workspace/database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from database/main/seeds/202609010002_permission_sets.ts (and the same for '../../../server/roles.js').
blockers.rootCause: The seed loader imports an application seed as TypeScript source, but Node type stripping does not rewrite a .js specifier to a sibling .ts file. The seeds were not self-contained: one imported database/seed-data/permission-sets.js and the other imported shared role and order-status constants from server/roles.js.
blockers.resolution: Made both seeds self-contained by spelling the role keys, page ids, settings targets, user actions and order statuses out locally, then deleted database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts and updated the comment in client/routes.ts. This matches the rule that seeds are applied history and must not import a shared constant that keeps evolving.

blockers.title: client-routes test pinned only the home page grant
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/client-routes.test.ts expected page authorizations to equal [{ name: 'home', authorizedAs: null }] but the application now registers eleven signed-in service pages.
blockers.rootCause: The test deliberately pins the route names that stored page grants record, so adding application pages is a deliberate data change the expected list must reflect.
blockers.resolution: Updated the expected list to include the eleven service routes, with service-order-new and service-order-detail inheriting the service-orders page grant. The test passes.

blockers.title: Server-only package @nocobase/cron declared in devDependencies
blockers.symptom: pnpm build failed at 'Verify server dependencies': @nocobase/cron is imported by server code but not in the application's dependencies, so dist/package.json would not install it.
blockers.rootCause: @nocobase/cron was declared in devDependencies although server/providers/inspections.ts imports it at runtime; dist/package.json is generated from dependencies only, so the deployed server would fail to resolve it.
blockers.resolution: Moved @nocobase/cron from devDependencies to dependencies in package.json and refreshed pnpm-lock.yaml with pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile. The build now reports all 27 imported packages reach the deployment, and pnpm build completes.

blockers.title: GET /api/service-engineers answered 500 for every caller
blockers.symptom: The order assignment and collaboration dialogs could not load engineers; the endpoint returned 500 with a TypeError.
blockers.rootCause: The /service-engineers route shared the order router but had no auth guard, so the auth context was undefined and resolveCaller threw.
blockers.resolution: Added router.use on /service-engineers with auth.required() and resolve the caller before querying; it now returns engineers across all engineer roles.

blockers.title: Every service.* UI string rendered as a raw translation key
blockers.symptom: Pages, badges, dialogs and error feedback showed keys such as service.orders.title instead of text; the language-switch check also failed.
blockers.rootCause: The application referenced 371 static service.* keys plus interpolated families, but no locale file defined any of them.
blockers.resolution: Added client/locales/service-en.ts and service-zh.ts (flat dotted keys, 377 each) typed as LocaleResource so Chinese is checked against English at compile time, spread both into en-US.ts and zh-CN.ts, and added navigation.*/roles.* titles; a parity script and the locale tests confirm zero missing or extra keys.

blockers.title: Confidential orders were visible to collaborating engineers
blockers.symptom: A collaborator could open the confidential emergency order and its attachments.
blockers.rootCause: listVisibleOrders and canSeeOrder admitted any order the caller collaborated on without excluding confidential ones, and canSeeConfidentialOrder ignored the collaboration set.
blockers.resolution: listVisibleOrders/canSeeOrder now exclude confidential orders from collaborators, and canSeeConfidentialOrder only admits the assignee or a coordinator.

blockers.title: Observer could read internal cost fields and write business data
blockers.symptom: The observer account saw laborHours/internalCost and could attempt writes.
blockers.rootCause: No field-level masking or write guard distinguished an observer from an engineer.
blockers.resolution: Added isObserver/canViewInternalFields/canWriteBusiness to server/services/access.ts, masked laborHours/internalCost on list and detail, rejected writes in POST/PATCH/transition, and hid the fields and action buttons in the order detail.

blockers.title: POST /service-customers and /service-devices returned 500
blockers.symptom: Creating a customer or device failed with a server error.
blockers.rootCause: The createOne call sites did not write createdAt/updatedAt, which are NOT NULL on both tables.
blockers.resolution: Both createOne/updateOne handlers now write timestamps; the same fix was applied to knowledge articles and inspection plans.

blockers.title: Order transition reported an error even though it succeeded
blockers.symptom: The status changed but the request answered with a 500 and the UI showed a failure toast.
blockers.rootCause: appendOrderLog inserted a null createdAt into serviceOrderLogs.createdAt, which is NOT NULL.
blockers.resolution: appendOrderLog writes new Date(); a transition now reports success or failure unambiguously.

blockers.title: Unsupported or corrupt uploads were accepted silently
blockers.symptom: Uploading an executable or a corrupt image reported success and the preview did nothing.
blockers.rootCause: The upload handler stored whatever it received and did not report a reason to the client.
blockers.resolution: Added a 20 MB size limit, an extension plus magic-byte allowlist for the supported document/image types, and user-facing Chinese rejection reasons; the client prefers the server message over a generic key.

blockers.title: Assistant message list crashed on stored references JSON
blockers.symptom: The assistant conversation page failed when a message had references.
blockers.rootCause: references is stored as a JSON string but was returned unparsed, so the client treated a string as an array.
blockers.resolution: Added parseReferences in server/routes/service-assistant.ts and mapped stored references into an array on read.

blockers.title: Dashboard had no region filter and no region/engineer distribution
blockers.symptom: QA could not filter the dashboard by region and saw no per-region or per-engineer workload.
blockers.rootCause: /dashboard/summary ignored filters and returned only metric totals.
blockers.resolution: The summary endpoint now applies region/status/priority and returns regions, byRegion and byEngineer; the page renders the filter controls and the distributions.

blockers.title: Recurring inspection and overdue-order checks were invisible and the weekly plan ran daily
blockers.symptom: The schedule administration page was empty, no order-overdue check existed, and the weekly inspection route was configured as daily.
blockers.rootCause: The work ran from a private cron manager the UI could not see, there was no overdue-order task, and the sample plan was seeded with frequency daily.
blockers.resolution: Replaced the cron manager with Scheduler targets (app.inspection.run, app.order.overdue) and three defineSchedule entries with Asia/Shanghai cron, added server/services/overdue.ts with notifyOverdueOrders, taught generateInspectionTasks to honor daily/weekly/monthly, and corrected the seeded plan frequencies in the new seed.

blockers.title: Automatic acceptance left no execution record
blockers.symptom: The order detail history showed no automatic-acceptance steps, no failure reason and no recovery record.
blockers.rootCause: Order creation wrote a single create log and performed no recorded acceptance workflow.
blockers.resolution: Added server/services/acceptance.ts, called from POST /service-orders and from a coordinator-only POST /service-orders/:id/retry-acceptance: three steps (registration, handling path, notification) are appended to serviceOrderLogs with result or failure reason, retry appends rather than rewrites, and the notice keeps a stable idempotency key so nobody is told twice. The new seed backfills the steps and demonstrates a retained failure followed by recovery on SO-2026-0005.

blockers.title: The message center was empty and the regional/observer roles had no accounts
blockers.symptom: No in-box messages existed and there was no way to sign in as an east/south engineer, collaborator or observer, nor to demonstrate team-inherited access.
blockers.rootCause: The first sample seed created only the five original roles and no team infrastructure or messages.
blockers.resolution: Added migration 202609010005_create_service_teams and server/providers/service-teams.ts registering a service-team authorization subject, plus seed 202609010006_service_repairs.ts creating the four new permission sets, two teams with inherited service-engineer grants and memberships, four demo accounts, in-box messages, corrected plan frequencies and the acceptance history.

blockers.title: Observer saw no orders at all, so read-only masking could not be observed
blockers.symptom: Logging in as the observer returned an empty order list and every order detail was forbidden, so the criterion that internal fields are hidden and writes refused had no visible record to check.
blockers.rootCause: listVisibleOrders and canSeeOrder handled coordinator, customer and engineer/collaborator scopes but not an observer, so an observer fell through to the assignee-only branch and matched nothing.
blockers.resolution: Added an observer branch to listVisibleOrders and canSeeOrder that reads the non-confidential register (confidential orders stay hidden, matching the observer’s field-level restriction) and added a canWriteBusiness guard to the attachment upload/delete helper so an observer cannot write. The visible list and detail still run through maskInternalFields. Verified live: the observer lists 16 non-confidential orders with null internalCost/laborHours while an admin sees the values, cannot open a confidential order (403), cannot upload an attachment (403), and can read attachment metadata.

blockers.title: A service team was not selectable when configuring permissions
blockers.symptom: The service-team subject carried an inheritance rule but no administration entry, so an administrator could not pick a team when assigning a permission set in the workspace.
blockers.rootCause: The AuthorizationSubjectType administration.selection contract was not implemented in ServiceTeamsProvider, so the subject resolved for authorization but was invisible to the configuration UI.
blockers.resolution: Added an administration entry with a localized title and a collection selection (list with search/pagination and resolve) backed by serviceTeams. Verified live through GET /api/authz/inspector/subjects/service-team, which lists both teams with code and region.

blockers.title: No concrete collaborator hand-over existed in the sample data
blockers.symptom: The collaborator account saw zero records, so "a collaborator participates only in records explicitly handed over" and the confidential counter-example had nothing to demonstrate before QA performed a share.
blockers.rootCause: The original sample seed granted a confidential order to the base engineer, not to the collaborator account created later, and the repair seed added no collaboration rows.
blockers.resolution: Seed 202609010006_service_repairs now hands over SO-2026-0001 (non-confidential) to the collaborator and, on purpose, also shares the confidential SO-2026-0004 to demonstrate that sharing never reveals it, plus a matching in-box message. Verified on a fresh database and live: the collaborator lists exactly SO-2026-0001, gets 403 on SO-2026-0004, and the direct and team-inherited grants resolve independently (deleting the direct grant left the inherited engineer pages intact).

blockers.title: POST /service-devices returned 500 because a blank category was written as null
blockers.symptom: Creating a device failed with a server error whenever the Category field was left blank; editing an existing device still worked.
blockers.rootCause: service_devices.category is NOT NULL with a database default ('通用设备'). The create handler always included a category key, writing null/undefined when the form omitted it, so SQLite rejected the insert with a NOT NULL constraint failure and the database default never applied.
blockers.resolution: Extracted deviceCreateValues(body, customer) in server/routes/service-data.ts, which sets category only when a non-blank string is supplied and otherwise omits the column so the default applies. Confirmed on a copy of storage/database.sqlite that an explicit NULL insert fails (NOT NULL constraint failed: service_devices.category, exit 19) while omitting the column succeeds with the default; added tests/logic/service-device-create.test.ts for the blank, supplied and required-field cases.

blockers.title: Select controls rendered raw stored values instead of labels
blockers.symptom: The device form's Customer showed the numeric id and Status showed 'running'; the order form's Priority showed 'normal' and Source 'phone'; the dashboard filters showed 'all'/'__all__'.
blockers.rootCause: The Base UI Select root renders SelectValue from its items prop. Application Selects passed only children, so the closed trigger fell back to the stored value rather than the translated label.
blockers.resolution: Added items={[{ value, label }]} to every application Select root (29 across client/pages and client/components/data-table-pagination.tsx), with labels from the service locale; shared option arrays where no name collision and inline arrays inside dialogs where shared consts would collide. A scan of client/pages and client/components reports 29 Select roots and 0 missing items.

blockers.title: Customer 服务等级 showed the raw key service.level.basic
blockers.symptom: Customer C-1006 rendered the literal key service.level.basic in the 服务等级 column and the customer form dropdown; the other levels rendered normally.

blockers.title: Server rejections were hard-coded Chinese, so the English UI showed Chinese
blockers.symptom: In the English interface a duplicate customer code reported 客户编码已存在。; every other rejected business write had the same problem.

Added tests/logic/server-error-locale.test.ts covering language selection, parameter interpolation and the order-status labels used by the transition message.

blockers.title: Seeded service accounts could not sign in on the running build

blockers.title: Cross-region knowledge sharing absent and the inspection execution view incomplete
blockers.symptom: DB Explorer showed only orderCollaborations with no knowledge share table or region/recipient fields, so cross-region share and revoke could not be demonstrated; the inspection plans tab had no timezone and the page had no execution history, while task generation returned 'Generated 0 task(s).' and a newly created device produced no task.

Separately, seed 202609010006 had set the unrestricted catch-all plan 华东区域通用设备周巡检 to weekly, so a device whose category matched neither of the daily category plans produced no task on non-Monday days.
blockers.resolution: Added migration 202609010007 (knowledgeShares with region/recipient/grant columns plus inspection_plans.timezone) and seed 202609010008 (catch-all plan renamed to 日巡检 and set daily, plan timezone backfill, page:scheduler.schedules access plus settings:scheduler.schedules read granted to every set reaching the inspection page, one worked ST-SOUTH share with reason, corrected in-app notice). Extended server/services/access.ts to resolve service-team memberships, rewrote server/routes/knowledge.ts with team-scoped visibility and share/revoke endpoints, extracted canReadArticle/groupShares into server/services/knowledge.ts, exported planDueOn, and added the knowledge share dialog plus the inspections timezone field and Schedules & history tab. Covered by tests/logic/knowledge-sharing.test.ts and tests/logic/inspection-schedule.test.ts; all three typechecks, Prettier, ESLint on the touched files and 325 tests pass. blockers.title: Region filter was missing from the customer, device and order lists
blockers.symptom: Only the dashboard offered a region filter ('All regions'); the three registers had no region control, so QA could not narrow any list by region.
blockers.rootCause: The list pages drew their filters from status/priority/assignee/search only. The orders list had no region query parameter and the customer/device lists had no region option array, so region was a display-only table column.
blockers.resolution: Added a region Select to all three lists. The order list sends region to GET /service-orders, which filters the visible orders server-side; the customer and device lists filter the fetched rows client-side, deriving a device's region from its customer because a device has no region of its own. Options come from GET /service-regions (distinct customer regions plus visible order regions) for orders and from the loaded customers for the other two. Added service.{orders,customers,devices}.filterRegion/allRegions to both service locale files.

blockers.title: A valid XLSX without xl/styles.xml failed to preview
blockers.symptom: A legitimate XLSX opened by the in-app Office viewer reported 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' and offered only Download; DOCX and PPTX previewed normally.
blockers.rootCause: OOXML makes xl/styles.xml optional and the file omitted it, but the @silurus/ooxml WASM parser requires the part and threw 'entry not found: xl/styles.xml', so a valid package was treated as unreadable.
blockers.resolution: Added client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/lib/ooxml-normalize.ts ensureSpreadsheetStyles(): for a readable spreadsheet zip that has xl/workbook.xml but no xl/styles.xml it adds a minimal default styles part plus the [Content_Types].xml override and workbook relationship, leaving any other file byte-identical. office-open-xml-preview.tsx applies it for format 'xlsx' before viewer.load. Reproduced the failure and the fix in a headless Chromium against the factory sample.xlsx (raw failed with 'entry not found: xl/styles.xml', normalized loaded OK); covered by tests/logic/ooxml-normalize.test.ts.

blockers.title: PDF preview navigated the tab away and lost the session
blockers.symptom: Opening a PDF preview blanked the page (about:blank) and dropped the session; PNG/DOCX/PPTX previews were unaffected.
blockers.rootCause: The PDF was handed to the browser's built-in viewer, a nested frame/URL the application does not own, so the frame could navigate away and a failure produced an empty page with no visible reason.
blockers.resolution: Added client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/components/previewers/pdf-preview.tsx, which fetches the file and renders each page to a canvas with pdfjs-dist inside the dialog's own document, sets the worker from 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url', checks the %PDF signature for a mismatched extension and shows a localized reason with Download on failure. file-preview-content.tsx routes 'pdf' to it. Verified the exact pdfjs render path in a headless Chromium against the factory sample.pdf (rendered page 1 at 918x1188).

blockers.title: Orders created from the report form had no region
blockers.symptom: Orders SO-2026-0019..0022 created through the UI showed region '—', so the dashboard's region distribution summed to 18 against an order total of 22.
blockers.rootCause: The report form chooses a customer and one of that customer's devices; the device carries no region and createServiceOrder wrote no region, so the created order had none and was omitted from byRegion (which filters out empty regions).
blockers.resolution: createServiceOrder now derives the order region from the device's region when present, otherwise from the device's customer, and writes it. Migration 202609010009_backfill_order_region fills the region of existing orders that lack one from their customer (declared irreversible because the reverse cannot know which rows were empty). Added tests/logic/order-create-region.test.ts covering device region, inherited customer region and neither.

blockers.title: Root account saw no Region filter options because it was treated as a customer
blockers.symptom: The root account nocobase (root) saw only "All regions" in the Region filter of the service order, customer and device lists, and GET /main/api/service-regions returned {"data":[]} for root, while the same account’s dashboard Region filter offered all regions.
blockers.rootCause: hasRole() in server/services/access.ts returns true for every caller.isRoot, so isCustomer(root), isIntegrator(root) and isObserver(root) all matched. /service-regions (and the customer/device list handlers) filtered records with isCustomer(caller), scoping root to caller.customerId === null and yielding nothing. The dashboard region list was unaffected only because listVisibleOrders checks isCoordinator before isCustomer.
blockers.resolution: Added a private hasExplicitRole() that checks caller.roles without the root bypass and used it for the restricting predicates isCustomer, isIntegrator and isObserver; isCoordinator and isEngineer keep the root bypass so root remains unrestricted. /service-regions now returns every region for root. Covered by tests/logic/access-roles.test.ts (root is coordinator/writer/internal-field reader, not customer/integrator/observer; explicit jobs still match). Prettier, ESLint and tsconfig.server typecheck pass on the touched files; 16 tests across the four relevant logic test files pass.

blockers.title: Device and customer list search did not reset to the first page
blockers.symptom: On the device list page 2, typing D-2001 in Search showed 0 rows with the pagination indicator at "2 / 1"; the matching device is on page 1. Real keyboard typing and native input events both reproduced it. The region and status filters reset the page, so search was inconsistent with them.
blockers.rootCause: The device and customer list search inputs only called setSearch(event.target.value). The page state stayed at its previous value, so when the query narrowed the rows below the current page the slice was empty while the indicator printed the stale page against the recomputed total.
blockers.resolution: The search onChange on both client/pages/devices/index.tsx and client/pages/customers/index.tsx now also calls setPage(1), the same reset the region and status filters already performed. Added tests/components/service-list-search-pagination.test.tsx, which renders both lists against fixed fixtures, advances to page 2, types a code that matches a single page-1 record and asserts the result is "1 / 1" with the record visible and "2 / 1" absent.

blockers.title: Customer/device edit form kept values from a previous failed submission
blockers.symptom: After a New customer form failed validation (duplicate code STALE-CHECK), opening an existing customer (C-1001) for editing still showed the values typed into the failed attempt — the code field read STALE-CHECK instead of C-1001. The same happened on the device form.
blockers.rootCause: CustomerFormDialog and DeviceFormDialog hold their typed overrides in local `values` state and the parent renders them unconditionally with `Dialog open={open}`. The component therefore stays mounted across opens, and `current = { ...seed, ...values }` merged the stale overrides over the newly selected record. Nothing cleared `values` when the record changed.
blockers.resolution: The parent now remounts each dialog per open session with `key={formOpen ? (editing?.id ?? "new") : "closed"}` in client/pages/customers/index.tsx and client/pages/devices/index.tsx, so a fresh instance seeds from the record. An earlier reset-in-useEffect attempt was dropped because `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` forbids it. Added tests/components/service-customer-form.test.tsx: fail a create, close, edit C-1001, assert code C-1001 and name Acme.

blockers.title: Customer Region was not required and a blank value produced a server 500
blockers.symptom: The customer form did not mark Region required and accepted a blank value; the create request then failed with a 500 (NOT NULL constraint failed: service_customers.region) instead of a field-level validation message.
blockers.rootCause: Migration 202609010001_create_service_system.ts declares `service_customers.region` NOT NULL with default 华东, but the form FIELDS entry had no `required`, and customerValues() in server/routes/service-data.ts mapped an absent/blank region to an explicit `region: null`, which overrode the column default and violated the constraint.
blockers.resolution: client/pages/customers/index.tsx marks region required, validates required fields before submit with a per-field `role="alert"` and `aria-invalid`, and keeps `region` in the payload. server/routes/service-data.ts returns 400 customerRegionRequired on create when blank and, on update, now omits the key entirely (leaving the stored value unchanged) rather than writing null. Added customerRegionRequired to both server locales and tests/logic/service-customer-region.test.ts plus the component test above.

blockers.title: Dashboard Knowledge articles count ignored article permissions
blockers.symptom: An Observer/Collaborator saw 6 on the dashboard Knowledge articles card while GET /main/api/knowledge-articles returned 5; /main/api/dashboard/summary reported knowledgeCount=6.
blockers.rootCause: The dashboard knowledge query in server/routes/dashboard.ts special-cased customers/integrators to `status: "published"` and otherwise selected every row, so it never applied the per-article read rule that the list endpoint uses (canReadArticle + groupShares).
blockers.resolution: Added `visibleArticles(caller, rows, shares)` to server/services/knowledge.ts as the single read filter, and used it in both server/routes/knowledge.ts (list) and server/routes/dashboard.ts (count), so the card and the list can no longer disagree. Covered by a new case in tests/logic/knowledge-sharing.test.ts (observer 5, coordinator 6).

blockers.title: Reassigning an order had no reason field and the history recorded no reason
blockers.symptom: The Assign engineer (转派) dialog had no reason field, and the order History recorded only who received the order, not why it was reassigned.
blockers.rootCause: The assign dialog in client/pages/orders/detail/order-actions.tsx only collected an engineer, assignOrder() sent only assigneeId, and the POST /service-orders/:id/assign handler in server/routes/service-orders.ts wrote a fixed `派单给 <name>` log line with no reason input.
blockers.resolution: The dialog now shows a Reason field, requires it when the order already has an assignee, and passes it through assignOrder(api, id, assigneeId, reason). The server rejects a reassignment without a reason with 400 assignReasonRequired and writes `转派给 <name>：<reason>` into the order log (first assignments keep `派单给 <name>`). Added the reason/assignReasonRequired locale keys and tests/components/order-assign-reason.test.tsx.

blockers.title: DOCX and PPTX previews stayed on "Loading preview..." (not reproduced; hardened)
blockers.symptom: The harness reported the docx and pptx attachments stuck on "Loading preview..." while png, pdf and xlsx rendered. The fixture fetched the correct bytes twice with HTTP 200 for docx/pptx during the run.
blockers.rootCause: Not reproducible: the same built chunks rendered docx and pptx correctly under plain Chrome/Playwright, under the real agent-browser CLI, and under CPU throttling and background-tab emulation, so no single environment-owned cause could be confirmed. The strongest source-level difference is that docx/pptx passed `progressiveLayout: true` while the working xlsx viewer did not; progressiveLayout publishes layout only once the host is laid out and visible, which a hidden/unmeasured dialog host can postpone, leaving `load` pending. A t-identity change could also have destroyed the viewer mid-load through the effect dependency.
blockers.resolution: Removed `progressiveLayout` from the docx and pptx options (matching xlsx), stabilized the translator through a ref updated in an effect so a locale/namespace identity change cannot abort an in-flight load, and added a bounded 30s timeout (OFFICE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS) that moves a never-settling viewer to the real error state instead of an endless spinner. Documented the observability gap rather than touching the harness. Added a fake-timer case to tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx asserting the timeout surface. Repeated full browser re-verification is still required.

blockers.title: Customer Remark was accepted but never stored
blockers.symptom: PATCH /service-customers/7 sent remark=QA-B02-Remark-2, the response and the list both returned remark=null, and the Edit form showed an empty Remark field after a refresh. Every other field persisted.
blockers.rootCause: customerValues() in server/routes/service-data.ts builds the write payload field by field and never read body.remark, so the column stayed null while the route reported success.
blockers.resolution: Added remark to CustomerValues/CustomerRecordValues and copy a trimmed body.remark into the returned object (null when it is not a string), so create and update persist it. Extended tests/logic/service-customer-region.test.ts to assert the value is trimmed and stored on update and written as null when omitted.

blockers.title: New order could not be saved as a draft, and a Draft did not visibly advance
blockers.symptom: The New order form's Create button and an unnamed in-form submit both created pending_assignment orders (SO-2026-0019, SO-2026-0020); there was no way to save a draft. Opening the seeded Draft SO-2026-0007 and choosing Move to Pending assignment left the status at Draft, so assign/handle/confirm/reject/close could not be exercised.
blockers.rootCause: The create form had no draft concept: both submit paths always posted without a status, so the server always created pending_assignment. On the detail page the transition button opened a confirmation dialog even for a plain advance, and the page chose which transitions to offer from the caller's role (NEXT_STATUSES filtered by canWrite) rather than from the server's per-order decision, which made the click leave the status unchanged when the dialog was not completed.
blockers.resolution: The create dialog now distinguishes intent: named Save draft and Submit buttons set a shared intent ref, the payload sends status=draft only for a draft, the server keys off body.status (draft needs no fault description and skips automatic acceptance), and mayTransition allows the reporter or customer to submit their own draft. GET /service-orders/:id now returns availableTransitions computed with mayTransition, and the detail page consumes it: a transition that needs no input (submit a draft, start assigned work, close a confirmed order) applies in one click, while one that records a reason or result (cancel, resolution, returning a finished order) opens the dialog, which now also requires a return reason. Covered by new order-draft-submit, order-create-payload, order-create-dialog, order-transition-actions and order-transition-route tests.

blockers.title: A rendered OOXML preview self-destructed at 30s, and a stalled viewer worker had no bound and no retry
blockers.symptom: The harness reported the docx, xlsx and pptx attachments stuck on "Loading preview...". Re-checking the built artifact showed all three do render in about 3s, but the preview then disappeared: at t~31s the canvas was removed and the dialog showed role=alert "Unable to render this Office Open XML file.", with no console or page error. With the parser worker made inert (Worker.prototype.postMessage no-op) the dialog instead stayed on "Loading preview..." indefinitely.
blockers.rootCause: Two defects in office-open-xml-preview.tsx. (1) OFFICE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS was armed at effect start but cleared only in the effect cleanup, never after load() succeeded, so a correctly rendered preview was destroyed and replaced by the error state when the 30s timer fired. (2) The @silurus/ooxml parse runs in a module blob Worker; workerTimeoutMs was never passed, and the library's worker bridge has no default timeout, while its Worker error listener only revokes the object URL and swallows the failure - so a worker that fails to start (its module bootstrap is racy in some browsers, as the harness's own minimal module-worker test showed) leaves load() pending forever. The harness polled for at most 12s, so it captured the loading state before the timeout would have fired.
blockers.resolution: Cleared the outer timeout on every path that settles load (success, per-attempt failure, and reportViewerError), so a rendered preview can no longer be torn down. Passed a bounded workerTimeoutMs (OFFICE_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS = 8s) so a dead worker rejects instead of hanging, and retried once with a fresh viewer (OFFICE_LOAD_ATTEMPTS = 2) so a transient worker failure recovers; each attempt receives its own copy of the buffer because load() transfers it to the worker. Verified live in a headless Chromium against order SO-2026-0010: docx (823x1065), xlsx (870x413) and pptx (823x463) render by ~3s and persist with no role=alert through t=34s; with Worker.postMessage no-op'd the dialog reaches the "Unable to render" alert at ~20s instead of spinning forever; png (32x32) and pdf (918x1188 canvas) previews are unchanged. Extended tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx to 8 cases: workerTimeoutMs is passed, the timeout is cleared on success, a stalled first load retries and renders, and a never-settling load reaches the alert.

improvements.title: Verify script short-circuits after the first failing stage
improvements.detail: The reported failure was Prettier formatting on five files, but format:check runs early in .github/scripts/verify.sh, so lint, typecheck, test and build never ran in the failing job. Only after fixing formatting did the real failures surface, which made a one-line-looking repair a five-stage repair.
improvements.suggestedChange: Run all verification stages and report every failure in one pass (or run a cheap aggregate smoke stage first), so a repair agent sees the whole failure set instead of discovering it one stage at a time.

improvements.title: Catch a server-only dependency in devDependencies before the build
improvements.detail: @nocobase/cron was imported by server/providers/inspections.ts but listed only in devDependencies. Development and typecheck both succeeded; only the build's 'Verify server dependencies' step caught it, because that is when dist/package.json is generated.
improvements.suggestedChange: Expose the server-dependency check as its own fast lint-like command and run it during development (for example from typecheck or a pre-commit hook), so the mistake is reported at the edit that introduces it rather than at the end of the pipeline.

improvements.title: Seeds must be self-contained and cannot import sibling source modules
improvements.detail: Both application seeds imported external modules with .js specifiers; the test suite loads seeds as TypeScript source, where Node type stripping does not rewrite .js to a sibling .ts. This is easy to miss because application server code uses the same .js-in-source convention successfully after compilation.
improvements.suggestedChange: State explicitly in the seeds/migrations guidance that a seed file must not import any application source module (including role or status constants) and must spell shared values out locally, with the source-loaded test failure as the reason.

improvements.title: Browser-QA criteria must be re-checked against the built artifact
improvements.detail: Several verify-2 findings were already stale: OOXML/PDF attachment preview worked live, and order keyword search was present in source and bundle. Re-verifying each finding against the current build before rewriting code avoids repairing behaviour that already works and focuses effort on the real failures.
improvements.suggestedChange: Before repair, re-run the exact QA action against the current build and record the observed result; treat only reproduced failures as defects.

improvements.title: A large key set is easier to keep parity-checked in its own module
improvements.detail: 377 service.* keys spread into en-US/zh-CN as two LocaleResource-typed modules made English/Chinese parity a compile error and kept the base locale files small.
improvements.suggestedChange: For a feature with a large string set, keep its keys in a dedicated LocaleResource-typed module and spread them into the base locale, rather than growing the base file.

improvements.title: Source-managed workflows cannot be enabled without an administrator
improvements.detail: WorkflowService exposes no enable method and materialized source workflows default to enabled:false, so an automatically firing workflow would require an admin API call that a seed or provider cannot legitimately make. The acceptance flow was therefore implemented as ordinary typed code with its own history records.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a requirement is to record the steps of an automatic process, prefer application-owned typed code plus audit/history rows over a workflow that cannot be enabled at install time.

improvements.title: A record-scope helper must enumerate every job, not just the restrictive ones
improvements.detail: The collaborator/engineer scope was written before the observer existed, so the observer fell through to the most restrictive branch and silently saw nothing. The masking and write guards were correct but unobservable, which would have read as a broken page.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a role is added, add it to every scope list (visibility, field masking, and write) and cover each role with a visible positive and negative case, so a missing entry fails a check instead of producing an empty, plausible-looking result.

improvements.title: A registered subject type is not administrable without a selection
improvements.detail: Inheritance worked end to end with only resolveFor/filterActive, but the permission workspace could not name a team until administration.selection was added. Runtime correctness and administrative usability are separate obligations of the same registration.
improvements.suggestedChange: Register every application subject type with both the resolution hooks and an administration selection, and verify the subject appears in the inspector options.

improvements.title: Cover the values a create writes against each NOT NULL column
improvements.detail: The device create 500 was a NOT NULL violation caused by writing an explicit null for a field the form left blank, even though the column has a database default. No test exercised the values a create assembles, so the regression was only visible at runtime.
improvements.suggestedChange: Assemble a handler's insert/update values in an exported pure function and unit test the absent, blank and supplied cases for every NOT NULL/defaulted column, so a missing field is a test failure rather than a 500.

improvements.title: A Select without items silently shows the stored value
improvements.detail: Base UI's Select renders its closed trigger from the items prop. Omitting it compiles and typechecks, and only shows up at runtime as an id or enum being displayed, which is easy to miss across many forms and filters.
improvements.suggestedChange: Wrap the Select primitive so items is required (or so SelectValue falls back to a provided label renderer), and add a repository scan or lint rule that fails when an application Select has no items.

improvements.title: Server-produced text bypasses the client locale system
improvements.detail: Route handlers returned hard-coded Chinese sentences; the client already preferred the server message, so the user's chosen language was ignored for every rejected write, not only the one defect that was reported.
improvements.suggestedChange: Give the server its own locale resources and a semantic error-key helper by default, and check in tests that a rejection for each language differs from the key and from the other language.

improvements.title: An OOXML viewer can require parts the format marks optional
improvements.detail: xl/styles.xml is optional per OOXML and a valid small-exporter file omitted it, but @silurus/ooxml requires the part and refused the whole document. The failure surfaced only as a generic 'unreadable file' message, which pointed at the file rather than at the viewer's stricter requirement.
improvements.suggestedChange: Before handing a document to a strict viewer, complete missing optional package parts (and keep a fixture that reproduces the sparse package), or choose a viewer that tolerates them.

improvements.title: Render previews in the application's own document
improvements.detail: A PDF shown through the browser's built-in viewer lives in a nested frame the application cannot inspect, so a failure is an empty page and the frame can navigate away and take the session with it; an in-page canvas render produces a visible, localized reason.
improvements.suggestedChange: Prefer in-document rendering (canvas/HTML) for previews the application must be able to explain, reserving iframes for content that is genuinely third-party.

improvements.title: Reproduce a preview defect against the real viewer, not by reading code
improvements.detail: Both preview defects were settled by loading the factory fixtures in a headless browser: the raw XLSX failed with 'entry not found: xl/styles.xml' and the normalized one loaded, and the pdfjs path rendered the sample PDF. Reading the viewer options alone would not have proved the sparse package was the cause.
improvements.suggestedChange: For third-party viewer defects, add a small browser harness that loads the exact fixture and asserts the rendered result, and keep the fixture in the repository.

improvements.title: Repair scratch harnesses must be removed before handoff
improvements.detail: The previous repair left a staged .tmp-ooxml-test/ directory (index.html, main.js, sample.xlsx) in the repository; it was not gitignored and would have shipped with the application.
improvements.suggestedChange: Put repair scratch work under an ignored tmp/ directory (or delete and unstage it as the last step) and add .tmp-*/ to .gitignore so a scratch harness cannot be committed by accident.

improvements.title: A root/unrestricted bypass must not satisfy restricting role predicates
improvements.detail: hasRole() was written for permission checks, where root passing every job is intended, but isCustomer/isIntegrator/isObserver reused it to decide record scope, so root became every restriction role at once and the customer scope (null id) emptied three lists. The dashboard escaped notice because it checks coordinator first.
improvements.suggestedChange: Separate "may do this job" from "is this kind of subject": give granting predicates the root bypass and make restricting/scoping predicates check explicit role membership, and unit test each predicate for root.

improvements.title: A dialog that stays mounted across opens must reset its own draft state
improvements.detail: Two separate browser failures (a stale New-customer draft, and a device form) came from the same shape: a form dialog rendered once with a controlled `open` keeps local `values` between opens. A reset effect is the obvious fix but the repository ESLint config (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) forbids setState in an effect body.
improvements.suggestedChange: When adding a form dialog, remount it per open session with a state-derived `key` (e.g. `formOpen ? record?.id ?? "new" : "closed"`) instead of resetting local state in an effect. Record the pattern in the frontend reference so new pages do not reintroduce it.

improvements.title: A preview that only fails inside the harness needs a bounded failure path and an artifact
improvements.detail: The docx/pptx hang could not be reproduced outside the QA session; the only durable evidence was the fixture fetch log. A viewer that can hang leaves no diagnostic and no recovery for the user.
improvements.suggestedChange: For any async third-party renderer, add an explicit timeout that surfaces the real error state (and keeps the download fallback), and have the QA harness capture a screenshot plus the viewer console output when a preview stays on its loading placeholder.

improvements.title: A timer that guards a failure must be cleared by the success path too
improvements.detail: OFFICE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS was cleared only in the effect cleanup, so a preview that rendered correctly was still destroyed and replaced by the error state when the timer later fired. The test only asserted that a never-settling viewer reaches the alert, which stayed green while the success path was broken.
improvements.suggestedChange: Whenever a watchdog timer is armed for an async operation, clear it in the operation's success path as well as its failure and cleanup paths, and add a fake-timer test that advances past the bound after a successful resolve and asserts the result is retained.

improvements.title: A third-party worker-backed renderer needs a bounded request and one retry
improvements.detail: @silurus/ooxml parses in an inline module blob Worker. workerTimeoutMs was omitted, the bridge has no default timeout, and the library swallows a worker that fails to start, so a racy worker bootstrap produced an infinite "Loading preview..." with no diagnostic. A fresh viewer recovers the common transient case.
improvements.suggestedChange: When handing work to a third-party worker, pass its per-request timeout option so a dead worker rejects into the visible error state, and rebuild the viewer once before surfacing the failure; assert the timeout is passed in the component test.

improvements.title: Assert the browser lifecycle of a preview, not only that its loader ran
improvements.detail: The unit test asserted that viewer.load was called once and stayed green through both defects, because neither the deferred timer nor the worker bound is visible in a mocked load. The real failure was only observable by polling the rendered canvas in a browser.
improvements.suggestedChange: For a document/preview component, keep the mocked unit test for wiring and add a small browser check that renders the exact fixture, polls the canvas, and asserts the content is still present after the component's own timeout would have elapsed.

buildReview.reason: 独立 Agent 评审完成；评分是基于本次证据的意见，不替代业务 QA 或人工评审。

evaluation.summary: 针对 NocoBase3 基础框架的只读评审，选取 5 个能力单元：文件附件与 OOXML 预览、授权与共享/限制规则、定时任务与执行可观测性、站内与外部通知、工作流/自动流程边界。证据以 packages/@nocobase 下已安装插件与同步 Skill 为主，辅以 verify-11/12 浏览器验收与 retro。整体判断：框架分层清晰、Skill 质量高，应用所需能力基本都有直接或正常组合的落点；主要不足集中在 registry OOXML 预览组件对第三方 worker 失效缺少边界、已安装的 sharing/restriction 规则插件未被应用采用、以及 source-managed Workflow 物化后默认停用且缺少安装期启用途径。B06 最终 blocked 被 VA 明确归因为测试浏览器的 module blob Worker 包装，不属于业务或框架实现的必然失败。

modules.name: 附件上传、内容访问与 OOXML 预览
modules.scope: 评审 @nocobase/app-plugin-file 的 Repository 上传/元数据、content route 授权边界、Registry component-ui 的格式判定与 DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 预览，以及 nocobase-app-plugin-file Skill 的集成指引。
modules.limitations: 快照只包含构建后的 dist 与 registry 源码，未运行应用；OOXML 实际渲染由 verify 轮次在浏览器中观察，本轮只读源码与验收记录。B06 在 verify-12 被判 blocked（测试浏览器 Worker 包装），无法据此确认框架组件在普通浏览器中的最终渲染成功率。

requirements.need: 多文件上传、上传状态、预览、下载、在允许时移除；业务保存失败时不丢已上传选择。
requirements.responsibility: 应用业务表单 + 框架 File Repository / Registry UI；上传与业务关联是两次提交。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 复用 FileUploadField/FilePreviewDialog，保存返回的 file id 到应用拥有的关联表，上传与表单提交分开 commit。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在 app/client/pages/orders/detail/attachments.tsx 复用 Registry 组件，先上传取得 id 再保存业务关联；verify-11/12 观察到 5 个文件上传成功后刷新仍关联。

requirements.need: DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 在应用内显示实际内容，不把内部资料公开到第三方。
requirements.responsibility: 框架 Registry OOXML 组件 + @silurus/ooxml 本地渲染，同源 session 凭据取 contentUrl。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 直接使用 registry component-ui 的 OOXML 预览，按需 materialize 并三方合并升级，不要重写格式判定。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用复制 registry 到 client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui，并加入 styles 补齐、worker 超时与重试；verify-12 中测试浏览器的 Worker 包装导致仍显示 unable to render（环境归因）。

requirements.need: 格式不支持或文件损坏时提示真实原因，不把失败伪装成预览成功。
requirements.responsibility: 框架 file-preview 的格式判定与错误呈现；应用可加服务端校验。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用 resolveFilePreviewKind 的 kind 分流，保留下载回退；上传侧做扩展名与魔数校验。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在 server/routes/attachments.ts 做 20MB、扩展名+魔数白名单，并本地化错误；verify 观察到 corrupt.png 与 .exe 被明确拒绝。

requirements.need: 无权访问工单的人不能通过附件地址查看内容。
requirements.responsibility: 框架内置 content route 是公开的，应用须在自有路径上注册认证与授权。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在贡献路由拥有的路径（/<name>:<action>、<accessPath>/*）上注册 App 级认证与授权，禁止 router.use 星号。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用自建 /service-orders/:id/attachments/:fileId/content 并在运行时检查工单访问权，未依赖框架内置公开路径。

requirementFit.reason: 需求列出的 PNG/JPEG、PDF、DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 本地预览、错误反馈与内容授权边界，框架都有对应能力与明确指引；Office 本地渲染与损坏文件分流是直接支持，内容授权是框架声明的应用职责。

usability.reason: 开箱 Registry 组件的 OOXML 预览在 worker 失效时无边界，应用必须复制并加固；Bearer-only 内容授权也需要按 Skill 自行适配，集成成本偏高。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确列出各格式的本地/回退策略、同源凭据限制、materialize 与三方合并流程、以及必须用真实文件验证 DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 的检查点，便于 Agent 正确落地。

design.reason: 上传 Policy 与公开 content route 分离、元数据与物理对象分离、格式判定集中在 file-preview，职责清晰；contentUrl 由 id+ext 派生且不持久化。

reliability.reason: 内置 content route 设计上无认证、无行级 ACL；Registry OOXML 组件对 module blob Worker 失效无超时/重试，docx/pptx 使用 progressiveLayout，可能长期停留在加载态。

modules.name: 授权模型、数据范围与共享/限制规则

requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 permission set、subject 继承与成员解析；应用定义岗位与团队。

requirements.responsibility: 框架 authz-sharing-rules 与 authz-restriction-rules 提供后台可配置的记录例外；应用也可自持例外表。

requirements.actualUsage: 应用自建 orderCollaborations 与 knowledgeShares 表并在路由内实现可见性，未使用已安装的 sharing/restriction 规则插件；verify-11 通过 B08。

requirements.responsibility: 框架 authorizeUnrestricted 语义；应用的角色判定。

modules.scope: 评审 @nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler 的 schedule 定义、target 注册、occurrence 生命周期、inspect/reportCompletion 与状态维度，以及 nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler Skill 与 references。
modules.limitations: 未运行 scheduler worker 或数据库；执行结果依据源码、Skill 与 verify-11 B12 的浏览器观察，无法独立复现调度时序。

requirements.need: 业务管理员可在任务页查看名称/时区/启停/执行历史与实际结果，不能把已触发当成业务已完成。
requirements.responsibility: Scheduler 提供调度投影、执行历史与状态维度；应用注册 target 并授予页面/设置权限。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 仅对需要 UI 可观测性的任务使用 Scheduler，注册 target、配置页面权限并上报真实终态。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用注册 app.inspection.run 与 app.order.overdue 两个 target 和 3 个 defineSchedule；verify-11 B12 在 Schedules & history 查看执行结果。

requirements.need: 每天 9 点（Asia/Shanghai）检查应巡检设备并生成当天任务，同一设备同天只一次；重启后计划仍在。
requirements.responsibility: Scheduler 提供 cron/timezone 与持久定义；业务幂等由应用负责。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 Provider 的 boot 中 defineSchedule 声明 cron 与时区，业务侧自行保证幂等，Scheduler 不保证 exactly-once。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用把原私有 cron 迁到两个 Scheduler target；retro 记录修正 seed 频率并让 generateInspectionTasks 处理日/周/月。

requirements.need: 失败执行保留原因；异步执行的真实终态可恢复、可 inspect。
requirements.responsibility: Scheduler 的 inspect + reportCompletion 契约；应用实现 observer 与业务 Job。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 异步 target 实现 inspect(reference)，并在真实终态调用 reportCompletion；重复终态幂等，冲突终态以 COMPLETION_CONFLICT 拒绝。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 target 返回业务结果；Skill 要求检查 dispatch→worker→terminal 全链路，retro 记录采用 Scheduler targets。

requirementFit.reason: Scheduler 提供 cron/timezone、持久定义、启停、执行历史与多维状态，直接覆盖巡检与超期两个周期任务及管理页观测。

usability.reason: 状态语义被拆成 enabled/scheduleStatus/targetState/occurrence 并反复强调都不等于业务成功，减少误读；但自定义 target 与队列部署约束仍需应用自己保证。

requirements.responsibility: 应用业务幂等；Workflow 提供 eventKey 去重。

requirements.responsibility: Scheduler 自有 target；Workflow 为可选项。

findings.title: Registry OOXML 预览对第三方 worker 失效没有边界，且 docx/pptx 使用 progressiveLayout
findings.detail: packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/office-open-xml-preview.tsx 为 docx 与 pptx 传入 progressiveLayout: true（xlsx 不传），且三种格式都未向 @silurus/ooxml 传 workerTimeoutMs。该库在 module blob Worker 中解析，worker 启动失败时只 revoke object URL 并吞掉错误，因此 load() 可能永不 settle；宿主不可见/未布局时 progressiveLayout 也会推迟布局。用户只看到 Loading preview...，没有失败原因或下载回退。
findings.impact: 使用该 registry recipe 的应用必须复制组件并自行加固，否则预览可能永久加载，浏览器验收只能记 blocked 或 failed。
findings.suggestedChange: registry 组件默认关闭 progressiveLayout（或提供显式选项），传入有界的 workerTimeoutMs，并在 worker 失败时进入可见错误态且保留下载回退；建议附带一次用新 viewer 的重试。
